differences.native: MySQL uses WEEKDAY(order_date), whose integer range starts with Monday at zero.
differences.app: SQLite uses strftime('%w', order_date), whose text range starts with Sunday at zero, so each CASE uses the corresponding shifted literal.
differences.rationale: SQLite does not provide MySQL's WEEKDAY function. All seven conditional sums, item left join, category grouping, projections, aliases, and ordering otherwise match exactly.
